# startai

> startai is a documentation repository of reusable, project-agnostic processes and templates to (1) turn a normal project into an AI-native project and (2) leave a project ready for distribution in a repository: bilingual README, demo GIF, static GitHub Pages site, GitHub "About" section, visibility and promotion, source-visible proprietary licensing, and dual release signing (minisign Ed25519 + post-quantum ML-DSA-65, FIPS 204).

Important notes:

- This repository documents a **source-visible proprietary** licensing model: your own code, visible in the repo, but private and non-redistributable. The shipped [LICENSE](https://github.com/SalvadorPalmaRodriguez/startai/blob/main/LICENSE) is a template whose `{{product_name}}` / `{{owner}}` / `{{email}}` / `{{year}}` variables are populated from `config.example.json` by `scripts/startai.py`.
- AI readability does NOT constitute a license grant. All usage is governed by the LICENSE.
- Security vulnerabilities must be reported privately (coordinated disclosure, no public issues). See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/SalvadorPalmaRodriguez/startai/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
- Releases are signed twice: minisign (Ed25519) and ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204). See the signing guide.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/SalvadorPalmaRodriguez/startai/blob/main/README.md): What this repo is, index of the two core guides, and `startai.py adopt` — layered, non-destructive adoption of the kit into existing projects (preflight checks, `.startai-new` conflicts, opt-in hooks)
- [Making a project AI-native (EN)](https://salvadorpalmarodriguez.github.io/startai/en/ai-native): AGENTS.md, .agents/ (agents + skills), llms.txt, public/private split
- [Preparing a project for distribution (EN)](https://salvadorpalmarodriguez.github.io/startai/en/distribution): README, GIF, GitHub.io page, About section, visibility
- [Licensing (EN)](https://salvadorpalmarodriguez.github.io/startai/en/license): source-visible proprietary license + third-party notices
- [Release signing (EN)](https://salvadorpalmarodriguez.github.io/startai/en/signing): minisign + ML-DSA-65 ceremony
